query: strict: plant in TITLE, indication in TITLE_ABS, title exclusions (cancer, nanoparticle, feed, pollen...)
judge: Claude (reading titles and abstract openings); not independent of the author - needs a human spot check
failure_modes: homonym genus names (Iris = eye iris; Quercus nematode paper)
over-general indication terms ('respiratory': fish anaesthesia, seed respiration; 'ocular'/'conjunctivitis': allergic rhinitis)
